decision: Selected the centroid of Maricopa County Assessor parcel 304-01-006N (owner of record NTT GLOBAL DATA CENTERS PH LLC, situs 10256 E Elliot Rd, Mesa), the parcel cited by every City of Mesa permit for the NTT Phoenix (Mesa) campus and the parcel that contains the city's permit geocode for 10256 E Elliot Rd, as the campus locator.

selected_properties.OWNER_NAME: NTT GLOBAL DATA CENTERS PH LLC
selected_properties.spatial_reference: outSR=4326 (WGS84) as returned by the assessor's ArcGIS MapServer

computed.method: Single-ring polygon returned by the assessor service in WGS84; centroid computed in EPSG:32612 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 12N) and returned to WGS84; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid

identity_bridge: City of Mesa Building Permits (dzpk-hxfb): all 54 permits at 10256 E ELLIOT RD cite parcel 30401006N and carry the city geocode (-111.612275, 33.35516); their titles name NTT throughout, for example 'NTT PH1 - shell building 5, office and vault 2.1' (PMT21-01151), 'NTT GLOBAL DATA CENTERS AMERICAS - PH2 - SHELL' (PMT22-17409), 'BUILDING 7 NTT PH3 - Shell Building' (PMT22-19910), 'NTT PH4' (PMT24-07027, Building #4), 'NTT DATA CENTER PH5' (PMT24-17530, Building #3) and 'EXPEDITE - NTT PH6' (PMT26-13890), whose description says 'NTT Global Data Centers Americas is adding an additional Data Center building in Mesa, Arizona as part of a 244MW master planned site'.
A point-in-polygon query of the assessor parcel layer at that geocode returns only parcel 304-01-006N, whose situs address is 10256 E ELLIOT RD, MESA 85212, matching the permit address exactly.

The assessor names NTT GLOBAL DATA CENTERS PH LLC (Sacramento, California mailing address) as owner of record (deed 20190499142, 1 July 2019; 101.68 acres). The same parcel was reviewed by us-southwest-p2 (hold of 23 October 2026), which recorded 101.69 acres.
unresolved: The position of PH5 (Building #3) within the 101.7-acre parcel is not published; the centroid locates the NTT campus property, not the PH5 building or the works extent.
The assessor publishes no positional accuracy for parcel polygons.

NTT Global Data Centers PH10 LLC's separate 170-acre parcel at E Pecos Rd and S Crismon Rd (313-25-962; repository hold 'NTT Mesa PH10') is a different property about 5 km south and is not part of this campus record.
nearby_records: Within 2 km of the centroid: the held AWS PHX066 parcel at 10437 E Elliot Rd (0.92 km), the CyrusOne Mesa PHX20 campus proposed in the same fragment (parcel 304-04-984A centroid, 1.09 km; a separate parcel, owner and operator) and the imported EdgeCore Mesa campus point (1.42 km). The us-southwest-p2 claim and the repository fifty-sixth hold for this NTT campus lie at the same parcel (0-0.08 km); neither was admitted.

consistency_checks.datum: WGS84 output from the assessor's ArcGIS service (outSR=4326)
